temporal_protocol.frame_rule: range(2,T-2); pairs only within retained frames
temporal_protocol.spatial_crop: author crop_8x8; central multiples of 32, remove >=16 total pixels per axis
temporal_protocol.pixel_input: lossless RGB float -> round-to-nearest uint8 PNG-equivalent; no MP4 decode
temporal_protocol.tOF: mean spatial L2 norm of Farneback flow difference; flow on full uint8 grayscale frames before crop
temporal_protocol.lpips: lpips==0.1.4, AlexNet, v0.1 calibration byte-identical to author's checkpoint

full_frame_pair_metrics.input_pixel_contract: caller-provided full RGB; spatial scores not requantized by metric pool helper

restoration.fps_policy: caller retains original FPS unchanged; no temporal resampling
restoration.spatial_resampling: one whole-input CPU bicubic x4, antialias=True, align_corners=False, clamp[0,1]

blend.window: positive raised cosine with 1e-3 floor on each axis

sampling.noise_rule: one Gaussian field per video, crop spatial offsets/8 for every tile
